responsive.breakpoint: mobile-first — designed for Android mobile web first (360px-430px screens), scaling up seamlessly to tablet and desktop
responsive.layout: Single column vertical stacks on mobile with touch-friendly 48px+ tap targets. Horizontal scroll pills for categories/packages. Multi-column bento grids on md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 and xl:grid-cols-4. Mobile sticky bottom bar for quick buy & cart actions.
responsive.typography: Fluid scaling with mobile base 14px-16px, H1 text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl, H2 text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl. High contrast text against dark obsidian background (#0A0C10). Inputs styled at 16px minimum on mobile to prevent automatic iOS/Android Safari auto-zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: All grid and flex items constrained with min-w-0 and overflow-hidden where required to eliminate unintended horizontal scrollbars.
responsive.tap_targets: Buttons, tabs, package selectors, and input controls have minimum touch height of 48px with generous spacing and optical alignment.

typography.heading_font: Unbounded, sans-serif (Google Font for punchy cyberpunk gaming feel)
typography.body_font: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif (Clean legibility for prices, instructions and transaction forms)
typography.accent_font: JetBrains Mono, monospace (For Transaction IDs, Order Numbers, and HTG Currency display)

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the frontend with high visual polish tailored for the Haitian Android gaming audience.
Prices must be formatted clearly in HTG (Gourdes haïtiennes, e.g., '1,250 HTG'). Include 10% default profit margin calculation clearly in backend/frontend math.
Implement MonCash and NatCash payment flow with copy-to-clipboard phone numbers, beneficiary name, transaction reference field, and proof image uploader preview.
Ensure all order status badges are clearly color coded: 🟡 En attente (yellow), 🟢 Approuvée (green), 🔴 Rejetée (red), 🔵 Terminée (blue).
Implement complete Order Lookup (Mes commandes / Suivi) by Order ID or Phone number with clear step-by-step progress status.

Implement full Admin Dashboard with Google OAuth authentication, KPI stats, Order approval modal with proof viewer, Product CRUD with margin percentage editor, Payment Settings editor, and Admin Allowlist manager.
Add data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, filter pills, order status items, admin controls).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic white backgrounds or plain centered Bootstrap styling.
Maintain high dark mode contrast with dark obsidian surfaces (#0A0C10) and vibrant cyan/amber/crimson glowing indicators.
Micro-animations on hover for all product cards, payment choice cards, and primary action buttons.
Include clear data-testid tags on all interactive elements for test verification.
